services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Preparing the children of today to be active participants in the science of tomorrow. SMLI's Summer Camp program blends immersive science experiences with classic summer fun, sparking curiosity while creating lasting memories. Every day is a new discovery! Campers entering Preschool-7th grade will embark on engaging scientific adventures, from conducting captivating chemistry experiments, investigating ecosystems, or uncovering the past with real fossils. Campers build friendships, get messy, and have a blast doing it! Unique Weekly Themes: Our weekly registration option is designed to meet your ever-changing summer plans. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Preparing the children of today to be active participants in the science of tomorrow. Explore the amazing world of animals by getting up close to some of SMLI's live mammal, amphibian and reptile friends. Discover what adaptations they need to survive. Play a food web game to learn how herbivores, carnivores and decomposers interact and rely on one another. Investigate the world of electricity by constructing different types of circuits. Use your own body as a conductor while learning about static electricity. This is sure to be a shockingly good time! The scientific method is another way of thinking. blurb: The Science Museum of Long Island (SMLI), is a vibrant science education center and 501(c)3 whose mission is to breathe life into science and kindle the spark of curiosity and a love of learning in young minds.
